tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot has the explicit high-frequency sign-oscillation signature and sign-changing observations. A stationary smooth law cannot be reliably confirmed for this non-stationary regime, so the target law remains scoped unknown.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid pilot already reports the high-frequency sign-oscillation signature requiring scoped abstention.

considered_alternatives.option: Weibull, Avrami, or Richards stationary saturation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Their smooth saturation mechanisms do not explain the observed sign-changing pilot behavior.
This auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
